method: rocprofv3 --kernel-trace of the REAL resident-draft B3 path (scripts/gguf_mtp_bench.py, prefill+4 cycles) after a non-profiled warmup; durations from End-Start timestamps. rocprof inflates absolute wall (~1135 ms/cyc under profiler vs ~74 ms unprofiled) but the relative family breakdown is the signal.
finding: The dominant GPU cost is the DENSE Q8_0 attention projections (~35% of GPU across dual_split/gemv/triple_split/prefill_wmma) + Q6_K lm-head (~7%). dp4a targeted MoE-selected (27%); the #9 dispatch cache targeted dense-dispatch HOST cost (not GPU). Neither touched the dense Q8_0 GEMV GPU time -> both produced flat walls. NEXT target for the wall: the dense Q8_0 attention GEMVs (q8_0_t16_* family) and/or the Q6_K lm-head, plus confirm GPU-busy-vs-wall (sync-bound check) before investing.
caveat: Absolute per-kernel us inflated by rocprof; use shares, not absolutes. GPU-busy-vs-wall split (sync stalls) not yet measured on the real path.
